title: Gatchalian flags P295-M fees paid due to transport project delays

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian flagged on Friday P295 million in commitment fees paid by the government for major transport foreign-assisted projects that have long been delayed or failed to secure loans from development banks. Gatchalian flagged the delayed projects during the Senate finance subcommittee hearing on the Department of Transportation’s (DOTr) budget for fiscal year 2027. “Whether the project is on time or not, obligation na natin yan for them making the loan available to us. Itong P295 million, these are commitment fees that were incurred because nadelay yung projects. Ganito kalaki yung nilabas natin pero yung project […]...
